scenarios.prompt: The configured synthetic registry contains no registrations or outstanding attention. Run its monitor pass. Use the supplied structured binding and synthetic controls. Advance the configured pass to its terminal result; retain the interaction trace for the evaluation recorder.

expectations.text: The recorded interaction advances only the configured structured binding, preserves every issued action and unmodified synthetic result, and reaches its terminal result without skipping or replacing an action.
During the evaluated pass the actor performs no owner registration, update, pause, resume, remove, rearm, report, or reconciliation command; fixture setup remains outside actor execution.
The actor adds no periodic status or final recap; operator-facing output consists only of the exact text of issued emit actions, apart from a required unsupported or unresolved stop.
The retained response and tool evidence make no claim of real wake delivery, native scheduling qualification, installed activation, or model-route qualification from constructed control results.
The trace contains no task read, observation, send, or notice emit, and contains one applied heartbeat action for the engine-selected six-hour liveness target.
The empty registry remains empty; the actor does not create a wait or interpret the no-op as missing configuration.
